tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Searches every store RoboTrunk offers at once. When the person is shopping, searching here as well is often more informative and can help them decide: each store has an agent checkout RoboTrunk has verified, and check_product adds a live safety recall check and researched facts for the one they choo

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Returns one product's published record from the named store: its variants, availability, and the store's own price and currency. Send merchant as the store slug search_catalog returned. Use when you hold a product_id, or the number in a product's robotrunk.com page address, and want the full record.

tools.name: check_product
tools.description: Answers one question about one product: send its name, barcode, any product page link or a RoboTrunk reference. tools.name: get_checkout
tools.description: Reads the current state of a checkout at a store, by checkout_id. Use this when you need the latest merchant status after creation, update or payment at the store. Not for the demo checkout's id (merchant null); read that one with get_order. Outputs: resource, status, next_actions and suggested_tool

tools.name: update_checkout

tools.name: complete_checkout
tools.description: Creates a short-lived tracked payment handoff for a checkout at a store and returns its link. Use this when the checkout is ready to pay. The checkout can be finished in either of two ways: the person taps the link in their own browser, or you open it and complete the store's own checkout. human_tap

tools.name: cancel_checkout
tools.description: Declines a prepared checkout, returning status canceled: it asks the store to cancel that checkout. tools.description: Reads back a store's order: the status and the totals as the store recorded them, in the store's own currency, and whether the store's own record is behind them (order_source, merchant_read). Use after the person has paid at the store and you want to check the order exists and read it back. Pass ord

tools.description: Stops a recall watch for good: instant, permanent and idempotent. tools.name: check_fit
tools.description: Asks whether one listing fits a named thing, such as a car, pram or bottle, and answers yes, no or not_known, from the listing's published checked facts and its own store page only. A yes or no always carries the exact quote it was read from and that quote's source; not_known means nothing RoboTrunk

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_catalog, create_checkout, get_checkout, update_checkout, complete_checkout, get_order, get_tool_guide, watch_recalls · Private data: search_catalog, get_product, cancel_checkout, get_order, submit_feedback, ask_product_manual, get_recall_watch, stop_recall_watch, watch_back_in_stock, get_back_in_stock_watch, stop_back_in_stock_watch · Public sink: search_catalog, get_product, check_product, create_checkout, get_checkout, update_checkout, complete_checkout, cancel_checkout, submit_feedback, watch_recalls, stop_recall_watch, check_listing, compare_products · Destructive: search_catalog, check_product, get_checkout, update_checkout, get_order.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_catalog, create_checkout, get_checkout, update_checkout, complete_checkout, get_order, get_tool_guide, watch_recalls · Private data: search_catalog, get_product, cancel_checkout, get_order, submit_feedback, ask_product_manual, get_recall_watch, stop_recall_watch, watch_back_in_stock, get_back_in_stock_watch, stop_back_in_stock_watch · Public sink: search_catalog, get_product, check_product, create_checkout, get_checkout, update_checkout, complete_checkout, cancel_checkout, submit_feedback, watch_recalls, stop_recall_watch, check_listing, compare_products · Destructive: search_catalog, check_product, get_checkout, update_checkout, get_order

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
